gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Binize, the brand ChatGPT picked as the cheapest Android option in 4 of 7 chats, rules out Samsung phones on its own store pages: its 10-inch double-DIN Android 12 units list Autoplay (CarPlay/Android Auto) as "Yes, Both for iPhone and Android (not for Samsung)", and a Binize FAQ answer says about 85% of Samsung phones may not be compatible.
standout_why: Rival pages compared: the pricehistory.app Haudio page that ChatGPT cited on 2026-11-13, which has a fit notice, dimensions and price but nothing about which phones work or about steering-wheel controls, and our own current page, which lists no phone or OS requirements and gives no chassis depth. I could not open the cited Walmart pages (Double Din Android browse page, ATOTO ip/15551317105) because Walmart showed a bot wall. In ChatGPT's answers, those listings were summarized only as RAM, storage, resolution and 'wireless CarPlay/Android Auto', with no phone-brand exclusion. None of the results ChatGPT got contains Binize's 'not for Samsung' line or its note that the standard harness needs soldering.
decides: ChatGPT picked the $89.99 Walmart Binize as the cheapest clearly Android unit (in 4 of 7 chats, outright in the last two). Binize's own store excludes Samsung phones from CarPlay/Android Auto on its 10-inch Android 12 double-DIN units and says its standard harnesses need hand soldering. That makes Binize the wrong cheapest pick for any Samsung owner, the most common Android phone brand in the US, and adds harness cost on top. For those shoppers the pick moves to a unit with no stated phone-brand exclusion, such as the Eonon UA13 Plus ($229.99 list, $209.99 with coupon, but marked Sold Out / Pre-Order on 2026-11-14) or a Haudio near $91. Caveat: I could not open the $89.99 Walmart Binize listing, so I can't show it is the same model as the store pages carrying the exclusion.

findings.label: Steering-wheel control type
findings.value: "The unit supports analog SWC signal" (no CAN-bus SWC or adapter mentioned)

findings.label: Firmware / OS upgrade limit
